# Register-ZbxPassiveProxyConfigHandler

## SYNOPSIS

Registers a scriptblock that checks every configuration the server pushes to a passive proxy session.

## SYNTAX

```
Register-ZbxPassiveProxyConfigHandler [-Name] <string> [-ScriptBlock] <ScriptBlock> [-PassThru] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Register-ZbxPassiveProxyConfigHandler cmdlet sets the configuration handler of the passive proxy session named in -Name: before the session takes a configuration the server pushes, it runs the scriptblock on its own runspace with the incoming and the currently held configuration. Returning nothing accepts the configuration; returning text, or throwing, refuses it, and the text is the reason the server is told. It writes the session only with -PassThru.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Refuse a configuration without hosts

```powershell
Register-ZbxPassiveProxyConfigHandler -Name 'dmz-proxy' -ScriptBlock {
    param($incoming, $held)
    if ($incoming.HostsByName.Count -eq 0) { 'refusing a configuration with no hosts' }
}
```

Returning text refuses the configuration, and the server is told why; returning nothing takes it.

### Example 2: Take only the hosts this proxy should monitor

```powershell
Register-ZbxPassiveProxyConfigHandler -Name 'dmz-proxy' -ScriptBlock {
    param($incoming, $held)
    $unexpected = @($incoming.HostsByName.Keys | Where-Object { $_ -notlike 'web-*' })
    if ($unexpected.Count -gt 0) { "unexpected hosts: $($unexpected -join ', ')" }
}
```

HostsByName holds the configuration's hosts by technical name; any other name refuses the whole configuration.
